name: Seminar Room 2B
hours: Seminars Mon–Fri Morning and Midday; study groups in the Afternoon and (until the curfew) Evening; the Judge Circle meets here Monday evenings.
sight: A bright corner room with twenty paired duel desks, a wall-length blackboard dense with someone's probability tree, and tall windows over the duel terraces. A battered projector shows a paused replay; a shelf holds thirty copies of the Comprehensive Rules, every spine cracked at the same chapter. Somebody has drawn a tiny bunny in chalk in the lowest corner of the board, and nobody has had the heart to wipe it.
things: Sit a seminar: Rules & Judging with Ms. Kirishima or Probability with Dr. Blum
Work through the problem of the week chalked in the top-right corner (Blum pays 5 cr for a first correct proof)
Borrow a copy of the Comprehensive Rules and look up the ruling you argued about at lunch
Join a study group at the back desks
Play the 'judge call' drill: one plays, one cheats subtly, one must catch it
Stay behind to wipe the board and talk to whoever else stays behind
Look out over the terraces and scout tomorrow's opponents
secret: Rules & Judging and Probability are taught here; Hana's slow route begins with staying behind after class, Noor's with the Judge Circle (Mondays, Evening; from D67 moved to the Afternoon). Blum's problem of the week is a small steady income and a study bonus. The probability tree on the board after Day 45 is Blum privately trying to compute the odds of one student winning ninety consecutive ladder games; he gets a number he does not like and erases it when anyone enters. The chalk bunny is Inya's.
